gaps.detail: device time derived from cpu_hz (64000000 Hz); PLL reconfiguration is not tracked
no power net drives the MCU (board.power.vdd_volts is not routed); VDD assumed an ideal rail, so power-on and brown-out reset are not simulated

note: This is a hosted nRF52840 peripheral probe, not a Feather board-level simulation. The exact Rust firmware is separately covered by the committed local CLI smoke.
